title: Intent-doc / NatSpec / code three-way disagreement on the expected post-wire principal (doc: ==0; script header: >0; code: two-sided bound) — doc lag from the skim-parking decision
location: doc 'Step 3' (Verify: principalOf == 0); ResetAndRewire.s.sol:23-27 (header: principalOf > 0); :231-239 (code: principalOf <= idleSwept && (idleSwept==0 || principalOf>0))
description: The intent doc instructs the operator to verify YieldStrategyDolaV2.principalOf(DOLA, original) == 0 ('pool was empty before wiring'), written before the decision (leg1, commit 71c545c lineage) to PARK the skim surplus as idle balance on the staker and let setYieldStrategy fold it into the V2 strategies as an unattributed principal buffer. The script's NatSpec header says the opposite (principalOf > 0), and the code implements a third, correct, two-sided variant. Empirically the code is right (principal 26.778 DOLA / 27.229 USDC <= swept 26.785 / 27.234, both > 0) — but an operator cross-checking against the doc's '== 0' during a live broadcast would conclude the migration mis-fired. Minor: the doc splits 'Step 3 reset' and 'Step 4 wire migrator2' while the script merges both into one broadcast.
impact: Law-2 faithfulness / QA: stale runbook verification values can cause a false alarm (or train the operator to ignore verification mismatches) during a live migration. No on-chain impact; the coded asserts supersede the doc and passed on the fork.

classification.assetImpact: None. Three-way disagreement between the intent doc (principalOf==0), script NatSpec header (>0), and code (correct two-sided bound) on the expected post-wire principal; the code is right and passed on the fork.
attackPath: 1. Doc instructs verify principalOf==0, written before the decision to park skim surplus as idle balance.
2. Code folds the swept idle into V2 principal (26.778 DOLA / 27.229 USDC), so principalOf is >0 and bounded by swept.
3. An operator cross-checking against the doc's ==0 during a live broadcast would wrongly conclude the migration mis-fired.
classification.likelihood: Deterministic doc lag; risk is a false alarm or training the operator to ignore verification mismatches.
classification.assumptions: Coded asserts supersede the doc and are correct.
